zod: Zod 4 is current. Use z.email() and z.int(); format errors with z.flattenError(err) or z.treeifyError(err). Do not pin zod@3.
date-fns: date-fns 4: the ISO week-numbering year is RRRR and the ISO week is II (not yyyy / ww).
hono: Hono 4: use app.notFound((c) => c.json({...}, 404)) for JSON 404s (the default is plain text). Test with app.request().
express: Express 5 is current. Wildcards must be named ('/files/*filepath'); req.params.filepath is an array of segments.
Express 5 sends rejected promises from async handlers to the error middleware; no try/catch needed.
ai: AI SDK 7: tools use inputSchema (not parameters); multi-step tool use needs stopWhen: stepCountIs(n) (maxSteps is gone).
Structured output: generateText({ output: Output.object({ schema }) }). Do not pin ai@4 or ai@5.
openai: openai v7 is current (needs Node 22+). Do not pin v4 or v6.
For new code prefer the Responses API: client.responses.create() / client.responses.parse() with zodTextFormat from 'openai/helpers/zod'.
@anthropic-ai/sdk: The Anthropic SDK is 1.x now; do not pin 0.x.
Tool results go back as { type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id } blocks in a user message, right after the assistant turn that contains the tool_use.
stripe: stripe-node major versions move fast (v23+); install the latest, do not pin an old major.
Checkout success_url should include {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} so the success page can look up the session.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: Use McpServer.registerTool() / registerResource(); tool() and resource() are deprecated.
commander: Commander 15 is current; do not pin v12.
Validate option values with a parser function that throws InvalidArgumentError.
tailwindcss: Tailwind 4: no tailwind.config.js by default. In CSS use @import "tailwindcss"; and @theme { --color-brand: #... }.
The CLI is the @tailwindcss/cli package (npx @tailwindcss/cli -i in.css -o out.css). Do not install tailwindcss@3.
eslint: ESLint 10 supports flat config only (eslint.config.js); .eslintrc files are ignored.
Use @eslint/js (js.configs.recommended) and the globals package for Node globals.
vitest: Vitest 5 is current; do not pin vitest@2.
Use `vitest run` in the test script for a single run that exits.
next: Next.js 16: the middleware file is now proxy.ts / proxy.js (middleware is deprecated).
Route params and searchParams are Promises; await them in pages and route handlers.
vite: Vite 8: set base: './' for relative asset URLs; extra HTML pages must be listed in build.rollupOptions.input.
Read env values with import.meta.env.VITE_*, not process.env.
fastify: Fastify 5 needs full JSON schemas (type: 'object', properties: {...}); v4 shorthand schemas throw at startup.
Add response schemas so private fields (like passwords) are never serialized.
@apollo/server: Use @apollo/server (v5), not the deprecated apollo-server package. graphql must be v16 for Apollo.
Throw GraphQLError with extensions.code (e.g. UNAUTHENTICATED, BAD_USER_INPUT); plain Errors become INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
@trpc/server: tRPC 11: initTRPC.context().create(); call procedures server-side with createCallerFactory(router).
Throw TRPCError with a code (UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND); plain Errors become INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
msw: MSW 3: use http and HttpResponse (rest/ctx are gone).
The listen option onUnhandledRequest was renamed onUnhandledFrame; the old name is silently ignored.
@aws-sdk/client-s3: Use AWS SDK v3 (@aws-sdk/client-s3), not the aws-sdk v2 package.
Presign with getSignedUrl from @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner; paginate ListObjectsV2 with ContinuationToken (1000 keys per page).
@google/genai: Use @google/genai (new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey })), not the deprecated @google/generative-ai package.
Structured output: config.responseMimeType 'application/json' plus responseSchema or responseJsonSchema.
@supabase/supabase-js: supabase-js v2: insert() does not return the row unless you chain .select().
Check the returned error and throw it; queries do not throw on their own.
jose: jose 6: jwtVerify(token, key, { issuer, audience }) must be given issuer and audience to check them.
uuid: uuid 14: named imports only (v4, v7, validate, version).
version() throws on invalid input; call validate() first.
valibot: Valibot 1: compose with v.pipe(v.string(), v.email()); defaults with v.optional(schema, defaultValue).
Do not pin the pre-1.0 API (string([email()])).
pino: pino 10: useLevelLabels was removed; use formatters: { level: (label) => ({ level: label }) }.
better-sqlite3: db.pragma('user_version', { simple: true }) returns a number; without it you get an array of rows.
db.transaction() needs a synchronous function; async functions throw.
drizzle-orm: With @libsql/client, pass a file: URL (file:./data.db); a plain path throws URL_INVALID.
zustand: zustand 5: for non-React stores import { createStore } from 'zustand/vanilla' (no default export; the main entry imports React).
Never mutate state in place; return new arrays/objects from set().
cheerio: cheerio 1.x has no default export: import * as cheerio from 'cheerio' or import { load } from 'cheerio'.
marked: marked 13+ renderer methods get one token object: link({ href, title, tokens }), heading({ tokens, depth }); positional arguments are gone.
